summary:
Grief does not take the holidays off. The season is built from shared rituals, so the absence of someone we love can feel sharpest now. There is no right way to do Christmas after a loss.

In this reflection, psychologist Natalia Cajide looks at making room for grief over the holidays, and at how to support someone who is grieving. Also available in Spanish.

Equal Psychology provides psychological support for adults experiencing grief and loss in Kew, Croydon, and online across Melbourne.

Medicare rebates available with a GP referral.

Read more: https://www.equalpsychology.com.au/post/making-room-for-grief-at-christmas
